chunks: And it was narrated from Ṭarīf ibn Sinān al-Thawrī, who said:
I asked Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام about a man who stole a free woman and sold her, so he said:

There are four legal punishments in it. As for the first of them: he is a thief, so his hand is cut off. The second: if he had intercourse with her, he is flogged with the legal punishment. And upon the one who bought her, if he had intercourse with her while knowing, then if he was muḥṣan, he is stoned, and if he was not muḥṣan, he is flogged with the legal punishment. And if he did not know, then there is nothing upon him, nor upon her. And if he forced her, then there is nothing upon her. And if she consented to him, she is flogged with the legal punishment.

key_terms.تُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ: his hand is cut off as the hadd punishment for theft
key_terms.حُدُودٍ: prescribed legal punishments under sacred law
key_terms.سَارِقٌ: a thief liable for the legal penalty of theft
key_terms.مُحْصَنًا: legally protected through valid marriage, making the zina punishment more severe

ai.seo_question: What are the legal punishments in Shia hadith for stealing and selling a free woman and then committing intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out several legal punishments connected to the theft and unlawful sale of a free woman, distinguishing between theft, zina, knowledge of her status, and coercion. It shows that legal liability differs based on the actions and awareness of each party, and that a coerced woman bears no punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5126 - It was narrated from Tarif ibn Sinan Al-Thawri who said:
I asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who stole a free woman and sold her.

Imam (as) said: "There are four legal punishments in this case.
The first is that since he stole, his hand is to be cut off.
The second is that if he had intercourse with her, he is to be flogged with the legal punishment.
The third is upon the one who bought her: if he had intercourse with her and knew her status, then if he was married (muhsan), he is to be stoned, and if he was unmarried (non-muhsan), he is to be flogged with the legal punishment. However, if he did not know (her status), then there is nothing upon him or upon her.
The fourth is that if she was forced into it, there is no punishment upon her, but if she consented, she is to be flogged with the legal punishment."
